scenarios.name: Save a generated part at its assigned output location

scenario_steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/single-occurrence.oad` is staged in an isolated working folder
a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is staged in its `extrusion` subfolder so the component reference resolves
the user places a second occurrence of the native part 60 mm along X from the first
the user simplifies the assembly with New Part File and accepts its defaults
the resulting part is active with two solid bodies and a source-assembly reference
the assigned output path is clean and its part file is absent
the part file is written to its assigned output location
the generated part remains the active document
